title: 凯尔·罗达：市场广度改善，科技股回调掩盖周期性机会
speaker: Kyle Roder

segments.en: Well, I mean, I think we are looking at the surface of a narrow subset of stocks, which we're under performing, and, you know, really could be performing simply just because of, you know, some rebalancing going into the end of the quarter, you know, some concerns about where we're going, where we're going with interest rates settings across the globe, and therefore, you know, where valuations are at.
segments.zh: 我认为我们看到的只是少数表现不佳的股票，这可能是季度末再平衡以及全球利率走向和估值担忧所致。

segments.en: But if you look at the sort of breadth of the market, really things are holding up, okay, there's actually a little bit of rotation going on in the United States, and some other markets across the world too, like cyclicalities performing fairly strongly. You can look at Japan, for example, as a bit of evidence for that.
segments.zh: 但看市场广度，其实表现不错，美国和一些其他市场正在发生轮动，周期性板块表现强劲，日本就是例子。

segments.en: And so, although there is this volatility in pockets of the market, generally speaking, you know, we've got oil prices coming down, that geopolitical risk premium diminishing. Yes, this might interest rate uncertainty, and that's going to continue on probably lead to our breaks of volatility going forward as well.
segments.zh: 尽管市场局部存在波动，但总体来看，油价下跌，地缘政治风险溢价降低。利率不确定性可能继续导致波动，但市场并非恐慌。

segments.en: But this is in a market that's sort of panicking or dealing with more uncertainty, if anything, you know, the markets are buying into less uncertainties. So, I think that's, you know, the story here is that it's kind of the inverse of where we were, you know, last year and the start of this year, whereas, you know, more or less looking at a market really dominated by tech and our performing by tech and then forgetting that, you know, there really wasn't that much breadth underneath the market and fundamentals in the economy were pretty weak.
segments.zh: 市场并非在恐慌或应对更多不确定性，反而是在消化更少的不确定性。这与去年和年初的情况相反，当时市场由科技股主导，但缺乏广度，经济基本面疲弱。

segments.en: Now it's the reverse, you know, we're just sort of getting caught up in the negative headlines in tech rather than looking at those sort of other broader opportunities in the market. Might some of these other opportunities also include China? I mean, the way valuations are, does it, in any way, look attractive or do we sort of set it out until we hit the bottom?
segments.zh: 现在情况反转了，我们只关注科技股的负面头条，而忽略了市场中更广泛的机会。这些机会是否也包括中国？从估值看，中国资产是否有吸引力，还是我们应该等待触底？
